eval: (async()=>{ const b=window.__bn; window.__NODET=true; const run=async(ch, x,y,z, who, n)=>{ await b.startChapter(ch); for(let i=0;i<80 && b.state!=='play';i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); b.step(20); const dad=b.chars.dad; b.switchTo(dad); const L=b.leader; L.pos.set(x,y,z); L.vel.set(0,0,0); for(const F of b.party) if(F!==L){F.pos.set(x-40,y,z-40); F.disp&&F.disp.copy(F.pos); F.queue=[];} b.step(5); b.toyFreeze(who); const st=[]; let i=0; for(;i<n;i++){ b.step(30); if(i%5==0) st.push(dad.toyAt); if(dad.toyAt==='box') break; } b.step(60); return [ch, who, dad.toyAt, dad.toyPlace, dad.pos.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(0)).join(','), i, st.join('>')]; }; const out=[]; out.push(await run('yard', 2250, -20, 300, 'dog', 80)); out.push(await run('yard', 2600, -8, 100, 'old', 40)); out.push(await run('road', 2300, -20, 760, 'walker', 120)); return out })()
